title: FloloreanerServer
description: Just the Ultimate SMP and PVP Server ever.
body:
🌐 FloloreanerServer – The Ultimate SMP & PvP Experience
Welcome to the official Modrinth page of the FloloreanerServer! We are a dedicated Minecraft community focused on delivering the most thrilling Survival Multiplayer (SMP) and competitive PvP action.

Our server brings players together to build epic bases, engage in tactical combat, and experience Minecraft with custom visual overhauls tailored specifically for our community.

🎨 Complete Your Experience
To get the absolute best visual and competitive experience on our server, make sure to check out our official custom HUD resource packs created by the FloloreanerServer Team:

🍌 RealBananiPack: The clean, yellow, banana-themed interface inspired by Banani_real.

🌸 AloPack: The ultimate vibrant neon-pink PvP HUD designed for maximum focus.

🦖 FauliPack: A custom HUD overhaul themed around the colors of Faulimon.

🚀 How to Join
Once the server is live, grab the IP and connect with your favorite custom HUD pack enabled to join the ultimate battle and survival adventure!

👥 Credits & Management
Hosted & Managed by: The FloloreanerServer Team
